from.description: A source file to read to obtain the required configuration

overrides.description: Optional overrides to merge on top of the base configuration

ConfigSpec.description:
This struct allows the config files to be resolved either from
inline yaml in the test plan or from a `FileProvider`.
ConfigSpec.title: Config Spec

Matrix.description:
A matrix of user provided value dimensions that is expanded out into multiple value sets for
templating the test plan containing the matrix.

Number.description: Represents a number, whether integer or floating point.
Number.title: Number

RawMatrix.description:
We support only providing dimensions at the top level if the user doesn't care about
customising matrix variant names or using more advanced features.

This enum is only used to upgrade raw dimensions into a [Matrix] when parsing test plans.

relative_path.description: A relative path to the target config file

git_ref.description: An optional git ref to pull the config file from (defaults to mainline)

org.description: The GitHub org to pull the config file from

path.description: The absolute path to the config file within the target GitHub repository

repo.description: The GitHub repository to pull the config file from

anyOf.description: Represents a number, whether integer or floating point.

Scalar.description: A scalar that is valid to be used as a template value for a [Field].
Scalar.title: Scalar

description: The top level config file for specifying an RTF test plan

description.description: A brief description of the purpose / behaviour of this test plan

environment.description: The environment setup and teardown to run around the test scenario

matrix.description: Sets of templating values to apply to fields within the rest of the test plan as a matrix

name.description: The name of this test plan

values.description: Templating values to apply to fields within the rest of the test plan

title: Test Plan Config
